verdict.rationale: Chargebee offers a REST API for querying subscriptions, invoices, and account data (chargebee-docs-1) plus official MCP servers letting AI clients like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT and Codex 'securely access selected capabilities' including subscription/invoice lookups (chargebee-docs-7, chargebee-docs-8, chargebee-probe-4), directly enabling agent-driven billing queries. Missing for 10: explicit documented support for MRR/delinquent-account aggregate queries via MCP or API, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server reliably answers such billing-state questions.
